items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: this Dave Harman who was from Williamsport and he wanted to know if I'd join the band.

ctx.x: So I went up with a couple friends of mine, up to Delaware Water Gap and played and while I was up there, I think since I only played a couple of nights, I got a telegram from

this Dave Harman who was from Williamsport and he wanted to know if I'd join the band. There's a guy in there, an excellent saxophone player by the name of Joe Venuti and I had known him for sometime and liked him and he played C-melody like I did and he was giving it up, something about his family and he wanted to stay in Williamsport, which he did, so they wanted to know if I'd join them and I joined them. I played with the band and by that time, I was a pushover for taking a year off to save some money and…

That would seem to be in my mind and it got there very easily, so I worked with him for several months and I gave -- that's the band that had heard my 'To a Wild Rose' arrangement earlier and liked it, and then of course they wanted me to do some writing. Any kind.
